title: Test-Time Scaling with Reflective Generative Model
authors_zh: Zixiao Wang 等（中国科学技术大学、MetaStone Technology）
paper_type_zh: 反思生成与过程验证器效率研究（ICLR 2026）
best_for_zh: 研究轨迹选择、过程奖励模型和推理预算分配的读者。
one_line: RGM shares a policy backbone with a self-supervised process scorer to select trajectories under controllable test-time reasoning length.
RGM 让策略模型与自监督过程评分器共享主干，在可控思考长度下选择高质量推理轨迹。
why: It evaluates a small process-scoring head as an alternative to a separate large reward model for test-time scaling.
inclusion_reason: It makes process-level trajectory selection and verifier capacity explicit components of test-time scaling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
External test-time scaling often relies on a separate process reward model to rank many reasoning trajectories. That can add a large second model and require step-level labels, while outcome-only rewards do not directly identify which intermediate steps made a trajectory trustworthy.

The paper asks whether one reasoning model can generate and evaluate trajectories with far less additional capacity. The goal is to make trajectory selection and controllable thinking length part of one deployable inference system rather than two loosely connected models.

外部测试时扩展常依赖独立的过程奖励模型对许多推理轨迹排序。这会增加一个大型第二模型，并需要步骤级标签；而只有结果的奖励并不能直接指出轨迹中哪些中间步骤值得信任。

本文研究一个推理模型能否以更少的额外容量同时生成和评估轨迹。目标是让轨迹选择和可控思考长度成为一个可部署推理系统的一部分，而不是两个松散连接的模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Reflective Generative Form shares the backbone of a policy model and a lightweight self-supervised process-reward head. The policy produces several reasoning paths, while the additional head scores their steps and selects a path; the paper reports that the scoring head adds only a small number of parameters relative to the backbone.

The scorer learns from final outcome rewards with dynamic filtering rather than requiring manually labeled process steps. This turns the model’s own on-policy trajectories into a training signal for selection and supplies low, medium, and high reasoning-effort modes at inference.

反思生成形式让策略模型与轻量的自监督过程奖励头共享主干网络。策略产生多条推理路径，额外的头为其步骤评分并选择路径；论文报告，相对于主干网络，评分头只增加很少的参数。

评分器利用带动态过滤的最终结果奖励学习，而不需要人工标注的过程步骤。这把模型自身的在线策略轨迹变成选择训练信号，并在推理时提供低、中、高三种思考强度模式。

title: Method
方法
html:
The model segments a generated reasoning trajectory into steps, extracts step representations from the shared backbone, and combines step scores into a trajectory score. Policy optimization uses GRPO, while the self-supervised process-reward loss relates selected step signals to final-answer correctness and filters inconsistent pseudo-labels.

At inference, it samples reasoning trajectories, scores them with the shared process head, selects a high-scoring trajectory, and produces the answer under a chosen thinking-length mode. The resulting audit record includes trajectories, outcome labels, step scores, selected path, and generated-token budget; a final answer alone cannot establish why scaling helped.

模型把生成的推理轨迹分割为步骤，从共享主干提取步骤表示，并把步骤分数合成为轨迹分数。策略优化使用 GRPO，而自监督过程奖励损失把选定的步骤信号与最终答案正确性关联，并过滤不一致的伪标签。

推理时，它采样推理轨迹，用共享过程头评分，选择高分轨迹，并在选定思考长度模式下产生答案。由此得到的审计记录包括轨迹、结果标签、步骤分数、选择路径和生成 token 预算；仅有最终答案无法说明扩展为何有效。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper evaluates 1.5B, 7B, and 32B variants on AIME, LiveCodeBench, and C-Eval, and reports that the reflective variants improve on their corresponding policy-only baselines. For the 32B model, the reported high-effort setting reaches 85.2 on AIME24 and 73.6 on AIME25, while the paper compares it with listed open and closed models.

It also plots performance against total reasoning computation and reports diminishing improvement beyond much longer reasoning lengths. These are results from the authors’ training and evaluation setup; they do not independently verify the claimed comparison with every proprietary system or establish that outcome-derived step scores are correct on every trajectory.

论文在 AIME、LiveCodeBench 和 C-Eval 上评估了 1.5B、7B 和 32B 版本，并报告反思版本优于对应的仅策略基线。对于 32B 模型，报告的高强度设置在 AIME24 上达到 85.2、在 AIME25 上达到 73.6，论文同时将其与列出的开源和闭源模型比较。

它还把性能相对于总推理计算作图，并报告在更长推理长度之后改进递减。这些是作者训练和评估设置下的结果；它们并未独立验证与每个专有系统的比较，也未证明由结果推导出的步骤分数在每条轨迹上都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The key change is to make generation and process selection two functions of one shared model, rather than pairing a policy with a separately trained reward model. It also treats outcome-only supervision as sufficient to bootstrap a process scorer through self-supervised filtering.

That is distinct from merely applying best-of-N: the contribution changes the verifier architecture and its learning signal. It remains a selection-oriented method, so its usefulness depends on whether the shared scorer genuinely discriminates trajectory quality rather than simply echoing the generator’s preferences.

关键变化是让生成和过程选择成为一个共享模型的两个功能，而不是把策略与单独训练的奖励模型配对。它还把只有结果的监督视为足以通过自监督过滤引导过程评分器。

这不同于仅仅应用最佳候选选择：贡献改变了验证器架构及其学习信号。它仍然是面向选择的方法，因此其价值取决于共享评分器是否真正区分轨迹质量，而不是只重复生成器的偏好。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Final-answer correctness is a noisy proxy for intermediate reasoning: a flawed path can end correctly and a sound path can make a formatting error. Sharing a backbone may reduce memory but can couple policy and verifier biases, and the dynamic pseudo-label filter can reject informative difficult cases. The cost of producing multiple long trajectories remains substantial even with a small scoring head. Reuse should compare against a separate verifier at matched total memory, tokens, and latency, and inspect whether step scores transfer beyond the mathematical-style data used in training.
最终答案正确性是中间推理的噪声代理：有缺陷的路径可能得到正确结果，而合理的路径可能犯格式错误。共享主干可能减少内存，却会耦合策略和验证器偏差，动态伪标签过滤也可能拒绝有信息量的困难案例。即使评分头很小，产生多条长轨迹的成本仍然很高。复用时应在匹配总内存、token 和时延下与独立验证器比较，并检查步骤分数能否迁移到训练所用数学风格数据之外。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when a system needs both long-form reasoning and a process-level selector but cannot afford an entirely separate large reward model. Evaluate the policy-only, shared-head, and separate-verifier variants under the same candidate count and total inference cost. Log the effort mode and selected trajectory, not just the final benchmark score. The method is most relevant to tasks with outcome checks that can supervise learning; it is less directly applicable when correctness is subjective or no final reward is available.
当系统既需要长形式推理又需要过程级选择器、却无法负担完全独立的大型奖励模型时，可以使用本文。应在相同候选数量和总推理成本下评估仅策略、共享头和独立验证器版本。应记录思考强度模式和被选轨迹，而不只记录最终基准分数。该方法最适用于可用结果检查来监督学习的任务；当正确性是主观的或没有最终奖励时，它就不太直接适用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read this as a joint policy–verifier design. The decisive checks are whether the process head improves selection over outcome scoring, whether its gain survives a matched-cost separate verifier, and how the gain changes with the number and length of sampled trajectories. Keep the authors’ reported “reasoning effort” separate from total compute: longer internal chains, more candidate chains, and scorer passes are different levers. An apparent scaling curve is meaningful only after all three are logged.
应把本文读作策略与验证器的联合设计。决定性的检查是过程头是否优于结果评分改善选择、其收益是否能在匹配成本的独立验证器下保持，以及收益如何随采样轨迹的数量和长度变化。要把作者报告的“思考强度”与总计算分开：更长的内部链、更多候选链和评分器传递是不同的杠杆。只有记录这三者后，表面上的扩展曲线才有意义。
